decisions.reason: The quote describes active search for GRN pathogenic variants in patients with neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis phenotype (CLN11). The abstract title and conclusion establish that CLN11 is caused by GRN mutations. The quote establishes the identification methodology but the surrounding abstract clearly establishes that GRN pathogenic variants cause CLN11.
